summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 (no changes made — investigation only)  ### What's actually happening The backend is correctly scoping watchlists by user (`user_id` column, `X-User-Id` header set by session middleware in `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`). There's no localStorage/anonymous fallback anywhere in the client. The bug is a **client-side race condition** in `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx`:  - `WatchlistPage` fires its `GET /watchlist` fetch on mount, unconditionally — it never imports or checks `useAuth()`. - `AuthProvider` (`client/src/hooks/useAuth.tsx`) independently fetches `/auth/me
